children.text: Participants
Superk: Neeraj, Siddharth Mutyala, Harsha, Sarat Chandra
ThinkByte: Pavan, Harsha Thota, Satish Chitturi
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on improving call management, lead follow-ups, and addressing communication issues.
Main issues discussed were call handling inefficiencies, note-taking discrepancies, and challenges with WhatsApp communication limitations.
Follow-up actions involve enhancing agent training, refining lead prioritization, and exploring automated systems for better tracking.
Decisions were made to improve internal processes, enhance communication strategies, and explore alternative platforms for more effective lead management.
Action Items

Satish Chitturi will compile and share data on team members' note-taking and follow-up activities by tomorrow, including information on who is actively adding follow-ups and notes.
Will streamline call monitoring process to focus on potential leads and establish a process to evaluate performance based on call quality.
Communicate updates to team
Implement and monitor follow-up processes
Satish Chitturi to send confirmation over Whatsapp or any text to start the project on Monday or Tuesday.
Follow up with Sonal to confirm if Superphone can automate the follow-up process.

Increasing Call Volume and Management
Decisions: Enhance call management system improve efficiency, reduce missed calls.
Calls missed due to high volume, agent unavailability.
Surge in inbound calls led to missed opportunities due to agents being overwhelmed, unable to handle volume effectively.
Rejected calls, inability to reach leads upon callbacks common issues.
Implement better follow-up mechanisms to ensure leads contacted even after initial missed calls.
Note-taking and Follow-up Practices
Inconsistent note-taking, follow-ups among agents, causing confusion, misaligned lead management.
Ensure agents consistently maintain accurate notes, follow-up schedules for each lead.
Specific agents, like Chand Bash and Muhammad Ali, not maintaining notes or follow-ups, unlike others like Somo, who are diligent.
Decisions: Implement agent training programs enhance note-making, follow-up actions.
Importance of note-taking, follow-up practices stressed for effective lead tracking, management.
Lead Prioritization and Follow-up
Inefficient follow-up processes, improper lead attribution causing missed opportunities.
Decisions: Establish systematic approach lead prioritization, follow-up actions.
Focus on prioritizing high-potential leads, ensuring thorough follow-up processes.
Implement automated systems streamline tracking, ensure leads not overlooked.
Difficulty tracking leads due to lack of systematic follow-up actions, notes.
Internal Process Improvements
Lack of structured processes for handling follow-ups, managing lead data efficiently.
Optimize internal processes to ensure consistent, effective handling of leads, follow-ups.
Efforts to enhance internal processes for better lead management, communication strategies.
Need for organized system to manage agent communications, follow-ups.
Decisions: Develop daily metrics for monitoring, improving agent performance, lead management.
Messaging and Communication Strategies
Decisions: Spread message sending avoid spam reports, maintain communication flow.
Refine messaging templates better engagement, clarity.
Develop strategies filter auto-replies, ensure genuine responses addressed.
Auto-replies create confusion, hinder accurate lead tracking, response assessment.
Strategies devised for sending follow-up messages, managing communication backlogs effectively.
High volume of messages leading to spam reports, platform restrictions.
Pain Point
Concerned about the inability to establish a connection when trying to call back.
Most of the people except for Tirumal issue, nobody is following up on contacts with notes and notifications.
The need to simplify the process of sharing daily metrics and following up is a key challenge.
The problem of implementing a Whatsapp chatbot for appointment and call booking needs to be resolved before proceeding.
Manual follow-up is required from their side as it cannot be done automatically.
Superphone's Whatsapp has a limitation where initially only around 1,000 messages can be sent, but this number slowly increases as more messages are sent.
The issue is that the system is throwing a spam error when multiple people report spam within a short period, leading to potential blocking.
